generation1_frozen_inventory.rule: These are recovery/execution facts only; no mathematical rejection or pruning credit is inferred.

live_main_refresh.comparison_rule: BR204 candidate remains a same-population replacement/MIN candidate only; V45 predecessor movement changes comparison authority, not already source-locked producer arithmetic.

proposed_exact_finer_partition.trigger: Only for a (b,d) quantum that cannot finish within the existing single-d timeout or is explicitly marked finer-partition-required by the frozen generation-1 recovery evidence.
proposed_exact_finer_partition.assignment: Build the existing deterministic BC vector for fixed b exactly as before; enumerate it in its source-locked deterministic order and assign BC record index i to shard (i mod 16).
exact_union_conditions: Every BC record index belongs to exactly one shard 0..15.
All 16 shard IDs must be present exactly once before a d slice is accepted.
Shard source locks, b, d, mu table identity, terminal-syndrome identity and partition count must agree.
Static BC state count, assignment mass and tail-slot assignment mass are summed across shards.
K8 bins, mu bins, mu-tail bins, raw objectives, positive capacities and evaluation counters are summed exactly across shards.
The 16-shard union must reproduce the ordinary unsharded fixed-(b,d) payload byte-for-byte after canonical sorting/serialization in a bounded regression before execution authorization.
proposed_exact_finer_partition.rationale: The heavy fixed-(b,d) loop is additive over the BC records. Partitioning only that loop leaves the A-side, g/e logic, qBC/K8/Picard-mu semantics and final global LP unchanged while reducing the wall time of a single d quantum.
proposed_exact_finer_partition.fallback: If any individual BC shard still reaches the hard timeout, STOP again and introduce a second exact execution-only partition below the BC shard. Do not raise the timeout as the primary recovery action.

conditions: Generation-1 worker/base/mu/terminal source identities match the generation-2 producer semantics for already completed d slices.
Generation-1 complete and partial artifacts are validated through the frozen recovery checkpoint/manifest, not inferred from job status.
V45 MAIN is used only as the refreshed comparison predecessor; no MAIN-bound value is embedded into carried bin arithmetic.
Any changed execution-only finer-partition code is proven equivalent on complete fixed-(b,d) unions before carried and new d slices are aggregated together.

implementation_obligations: Add a source-locked worker mode for exact BC-shard selection without changing the default unsharded output semantics.
Add an exact 16-shard combiner that rejects gaps, overlaps, duplicate shard IDs, source drift and inconsistent static metadata.
Extend recovery manifests so partially completed finer shards are durable and only missing shard IDs are recomputed.
Refresh heavy workflow/runkey/execution-contract/source locks to V45 and the finer-partition surface.
Run exact-head retained replay and obtain a fresh hostile audit before any generation-2 runkey-only arm commit.
